title: Wire susi_harness::recursive into supervisor and layer daemon.harness over susi_core::delegation
goal: Reconcile the Mandate 73 recursion overlap documented in `docs/recursive-delegation.md`: wire `susi_harness::recursive` into production callers in `susi_harness::supervisor` and `susi_harness::operator` without adding a `susi-harness -> susi-core` dependency edge, layer `daemon.harness` socket operations and `RecursiveTaskNode` waves over `susi_core::delegation::DelegationScope` (`DelegationAuthority::host()` signed envelopes, permission subsets, micro-USD sibling budget reservations and refunds, deadlines, depth, fan-out, cycle detection, and cooperative cancellation), and expose signed envelope revocation (`CapabilityRegistry::revoke_delegation` / `serve_nested("revoke")` and `daemon.harness` `revoke_delegation`).

results.clippy_all_targets: pass (susi-core, susi-harness, susi-daemon: 0 warnings with -D warnings, 44256 ms)

limitations: Standalone CLI `susi harness run`, GEMI worker delegation, and GAWD swarm hand-offs do not open `DelegationScope`s yet.
Envelope revocation is per admitting host process (`CapabilityRegistry::serve_nested` and `daemon.harness`); `susi os capabilities` CLI does not yet expose a `revoke` subcommand.
